tools.name: funding_feed_pass
tools.description: Buy a pass for the funding feed: plan "24h" is one $0.250 payment, plan "7d" is one $1.000 payment for 7 days (x402 over MCP, USDC on Base), instead of $0.002 per call. Returns a bearer token (pass it as arguments.pass of funding_rates, or as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" on MCP or HTTP requests t

tools.name: funding_peek
tools.description: FREE. BTC funding (% per 8h) on each of the 5 venues, without other symbols, spreads or extremes. Use it to check the feed works from here before paying.

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, receiving address, the exact x402-over-MCP retry format, the 24h pass, and the equivalent plain HTTP endpoints (also payable by a plain USDC transfer on Base).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "funding_feed_pass" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
